title: Rice finished, no danger

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Our rice is finished. Can someone bring food today?

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Is the house flooding, or is anyone sick?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Neither. Sorry, I should have said that first.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Mae Tha District, Lampang, by the invented stone arch. Not a street address.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: How many people are eating there?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Three. Two adults and one child. Everyone can walk.
